title: Classic Chilli Cheese Toast
method: Mix together all the ingredients and top on the bread

While a tava works great, if you do have an airfryer i recommend using that for sure as it melts the cheese better and the crisp bread is even nicer in that :) also if you use an air fryer you dont need the butter to put on the pan!
caption:
Classic Chilli Cheese Toast
C: 17 | F: 9 | P: 9
Calories: 185 per piece
Makes 2 pieces

Ingredients
2 cheese cubes
1/2 capsicum, small cubes 
1  - 2 green chillies, finely chopped
1 - 2 tsp oregano
1-2 tbsp milk 
2 brown bread slices
butter

mix together all the ingredients and top on the bread
while a tava works great, if you do have an airfryer i recommend using that for sure as it melts the cheese better and the crisp bread is even nicer in that :) also if you use an air fryer you dont need the butter to put on the pan!
